A seemingly insignificant maid who had always stayed by Princess Xiao’s side suddenly revealed her formidable strength, suppressing all the prodigies: “You’re all wrong. Her Highness loves me the most!”

120087.synopsis:
After a car accident, Yu Ying became a newly admitted concubine in Emperor Kangxi’s palace. Fortunately, her immediate superior was easy to get along with, so perhaps she could just scr*pe by.
Just when Yu Ying was planning to lie flat and muddle through like this, she suddenly caught Kangxi’s eye.
Yu Ying, on the verge of death, jolted upright in shock—since things had come to this, did that mean she could dare to fantasize about becoming a favored imperial consort?
But…wasn’t this all happening a little too easily?
Ever since Kangxi had favored this little concubine, he’d somehow gained a cheat ability: he could hear her thoughts—and in doing so, discovered just how different she was.
What? The little concubine wanted to go home?
Impossible. Since she had come to his Great Qing, she ought to stay properly by his side.
What? She wanted to be a pampered consort? Then he’d simply favor her a little more.
And so, as he indulged her more and more, Kangxi gradually realized that at some point, this little concubine had already been spoiled to the point of utter lawlessness.
But he had no intention of reproaching her—in fact, there was every sign it was only going to get worse…
“Everything you wish for—I will personally lay at your feet.”

121367.synopsis:
“It means we need a proper driver. Not some third-rate hack who can barely scr*pe together a single point.”
A race car with terrible performance, a teammate who picks a fight every day, and poor results to top it all off. Daniel Lindbergh, the first driver for a lower-mid-tier F1 team, is living through a hellish nightmare, day after day.
He stomps on the accelerator as if his life depends on it, all to keep a promise to his younger brother: that he would expose their father’s ab*se once he became World Champion. But countless times, he’s been overwhelmed by a sense of powerlessness in the face of his bleak reality.
Then, one day, the newly appointed team sponsor, Alex Walker, informs him that his contract is being terminated due to his performance.
“Daniel Lindbergh. Our contract ends this season. Start looking for a seat with another team for next year.”
Fired. Released. Contract terminated.
“I want to drain the stagnant water that’s been left to rot in my team, just like you.”
“If you want to keep your seat, bring me a championship trophy by this summer.”
Every single word from the man, who was born arrogant and finds wasting time the most dⁱsgʊstⁱng thing in the world, strikes a direct hit. These arrows become sparks, igniting the fighting spirit in Daniel’s eyes…
“You’d better clear a space on your shelf. I’ll bring you that trophy you keep chanting about like a spell.”

171031.synopsis:
Chen Beihe and Chu Xinglan are the most popular professional players in the Sacred Realm League. Known for being constantly at each other’s throats, rumors suggest their Alpha pheromones are mutually exclusive a classic case of “one mountain cannot hold two tigers.” Their respective teams have been bitter rivals for years, and their fans are infamous for their explosive online feuds.
During the S4 All-Star “tr*sh talk” segment:
Chu Xinglan: “The player I want to kill most is you. Taking you down always puts me in the best mood~”
Chen Beihe: “Oh? If I don’t beat you into the dirt today, I’ll take your last name!”
Fans and fellow players alike were chanting: “Fight! Fight! Fight!”
However, when the new season’s transfer window opened, Chu Xinglan unexpectedly joined Chen Beihe’s team. The two arch-nemeses were now teammates.
After a training session back at the dorms, Chu Xinglan suffered a sudden rut. When Chen Beihe curiously stepped closer to check on him, the spiraling Alpha pinned him down and kissed him on the spot.
As Chen Beihe was kissed into a daze, a strange heat surged deep within his body. Crap… it feels like he’s about to manifest.
Both star players were eventually rushed to the hospital by ambulance, and paparazzi photos immediately topped the trending charts.
Passersby speculated: “Did they actually have a physical brawl?”
Others wondered: “I wonder who won the fight?”
The consensus: “Rivals beating each other into the hospital this is the funniest joke in Esports history, haha!”
In reality, the two men who hadn’t fought but had instead locked lips woke up and stared at each other in stunned silence. From that day on, the atmosphere shifted. They were lifelong rivals, yet their pheromones were somehow… perfectly compatible? Furthermore, the way Chu Xinglan looked at him was becoming increasingly “wrong.”
What no one knows is that Chen Beihe and Chu Xinglan are actually childhood friends. They’ve been bickering and “enemies” since kindergarten. While labeled as rivals, they are the most important person in each other’s hearts.
“We grew up together, debuted as pro players in the same year, and announced our retirement together. Now, I want to walk the rest of my life by your side.”

172823.synopsis:
(Strong Female Lead + No Romance + Power Fantasy + Apocalypse Survival)
Cheng Shuili dropped dead after working 72 hours straight overtime.
When she came back to life, she unexpectedly found herself transported into a highway survival game world.
Right at the start, she draws an SSS-tier talent: [Bug Physique] —allowing her to exploit system loopholes for her own benefit.
A supply crate spawns a monster? She turns around and scores the server’s first kill!
The crate doesn’t disappear after being opened? Infinite farming unlocked!
While others are gnawing on compressed biscuits, she’s enjoying self-heating hot pot.
While others tremble in fear hiding from monsters, she chases them down with a metal pipe and beats them senseless.
While everyone else is still struggling to survive, Cheng Shuili is already speeding down the highway in a shopping cart blaring a hypnotic ad: “Everything Half Price!”
“Honestly, this crappy game is way more fun than fixing code—whoever wants to go back to overtime can go ahead!”

197399.synopsis:
Yakumo Amamiya was an ordinary first-year high school student you could find anywhere.
In other words, he was nothing more than a background character.
Like any proper background character, nothing particularly exciting ever happened to him. He spent his days enjoying a peaceful, uneventful high school life.
But one day, everything changed.
At his school, there were the famous Yoshino twins—Fuka and Raika—two stunning beauties rumored to never let any boy get close to them.
Through an unexpected twist of fate, Yakumo found himself becoming involved with both sisters.
As he helped them confront the troubles they carried, the twins gradually opened up to him. Trust slowly grew between them, and before long, that trust blossomed into affection.
Handsome heartthrobs and star athletes approached the beautiful sisters one after another.
The twins rejected every single one of them without hesitation.
Yet somehow, they always ended up returning to Yakumo instead.
And to make things even more complicated…
Their feelings seemed to be a little heavier than he expected.
The ordinary daily life of a boy who had once been nothing more than a background character slowly began to change.

198935.synopsis:
In her previous life, Qiu Yun toiled endlessly, finally helping her young mistress live long enough to become the matriarch of a noble household. She hadn’t even enjoyed a single day of leisure before she suddenly dropped dead.
When she opened her eyes again, she had transmigrated into the body of a young maid in the modern wealthy Jiang family.
The good news—she was twenty years younger.
The bad news—the original owner was a brainless, busty trophy who was planning to seduce the eldest young master.
Qiu Yun: “…What a failed start.”
At that time, the Jiang Group was in the midst of a power transition, with all four branches of the family fiercely eyeing the heir’s position and internal conflicts never-ending.
She belonged to the eldest branch, which had the advantage of the firstborn son’s title but was a complete mess inside: the matriarch was indifferent, the servants were lazy, and the father and son were estranged.
Qiu Yun calmly rolled up her uniform sleeves:
Power struggles in a wealthy household? This, I know well.
So—
At the birthday banquet, the second branch tried to sow discord. Qiu Yun performed a lost ancient style of tea ceremony, the foam painting exquisite as art, astonishing the entire room of guests.
At the annual gala, someone secretly tried to sabotage an elder. Qiu Yun used acupressure to induce vomiting, saving the patriarch and turning around to expose the traitor.
With Qiu Yun’s help, the eldest branch not only held their existing advantages but also gained wise counsel, successfully inheriting the company and rising to power. She, in turn, achieved financial freedom, holding stock dividends and walking the path to her life’s peak.
Later, under the brilliant lights of the celebration banquet,
Qiu Yun attended the group’s media event in an entirely new identity.
In the shadows of the hallway, Pei Cizhou, his eyes red, pressed her against the corner, his voice trembling.
“You said you liked eighteen-year-olds…”
“You really meant the age!”
–
Eldritch, sly old-soul maid × broken, black-to-white wounded young master
Wealthy family power struggles + workplace advancement, a refreshing and gratifying upgrade story
Heads-up: The male lead falls first and breaks down first. They are a year-younger confrontation-style couple. No mindless pampering from the start. Don’t read if you can’t handle it.

205591.synopsis:
When Gu Yuechan was six, she was betrothed to the second son of the Marquis of Changping.
After returning from mourning, the marriage, which had already been scheduled, suddenly encountered setbacks.
Rumor had it that the new Emperor had been deposed as Crown Prince due to the slanders of Noble Consort Zheng, and had lived in a Taoist temple for many years.
The current Marchioness of Changping naturally refused to let the daughter of the Zheng clan marry her son.
Relying on her beauty, Gu Yuechan would not accept such humiliation; she regrouped and set out to find a match even better than the Changping estate.
After much picking and choosing, she finally settled on the second son of the Duke of Ping.
Although he could not inherit the dukedom, he was young and obedient—enough for her to walk sideways in the capital (act with impunity).
However, on the very day of the betrothal, an imperial decree summoned her to the palace as a concubine.
Thinking of the cold-hearted new Emperor she had heard about from others, she hid and cried for several days.
She thought entering the palace was the new Emperor’s revenge, but the moment she saw him, Gu Yuechan blurted out: “Taoist priest.”
Back when she was trying to resolve her family’s predicament, she had offered gold and silver to a Taoist priest, begging him to put in a good word for her father before the Sage.
The priest kept his word, and her father did indeed return to the imperial court.
The once ethereal priest was now dressed in black brocade, his face gloomy as he pinched her chin.
“If you want to walk sideways in the capital, why not come to my side?”

208919.synopsis:
Inexplicably transmigrated to the interstellar era, Shi Lu became an orphan who survived by scavenging on a remote planet.
After a day of scavenging, Shi Lu said: “Whoever wants to pick through this garbage can do it! I’m going to get rich overnight!”
Rolling up her sleeves, Shi Lu prepared to return to her old profession. However… What? Due to constant wars and a cultural fracture in the interstellar era, the game rankings were filled with nothing but violent combat games, and there wasn’t a single other playable game to be found?
After thinking it over, Shi Lu gave a crooked smile. Since she couldn’t be a game streamer, she would just make her own games to play. Thus, she pulled out a specialty from Ancient Blue Star—horror games.
To the interstellar people who suffered from a cultural fracture and didn’t even know what a “ghost” was, Shi Lu personally supplied them with the unforgettable “childhood trauma” they had missed out on.
At first, the interstellar people were dismissive: “Going Home? Making a game about just going home? What, is the developer still in diapers?”
After playing: “Forget it, this home is not worth returning to!”
Later, as horror games like “Going Home,” “Huai’an High School,” and “Dream Ghost” were released one after another, people across the galaxy began to get paranoid:
Is the person in the mirror still me?
There seems to be someone under the bed!
Even interstellar people, who previously had no concept of ghosts, began discussing “haunting” incidents: “I heard from my sister’s classmate’s younger sister’s friend…”
Some, sporting dark circles after a sleepless night, completely lost it and began cursing:“That damn horror game developer! Waaa… I don’t dare turn off the lights to sleep anymore!”
Meanwhile, the mastermind behind it all, Shi Lu: “Achoo! Who’s thinking about me?”

209943.synopsis:
When Lang Shuo woke up, he had transmigrated into a severely wounded snow wolf on the verge of death. Before he could even grieve over transmigrating, he first saw an entire cave full of fluffy creatures.
Lang Shuo: You might not believe me, but the wound stopped hurting right then and there!
Hopelessly addicted to petting fluff, Lang Shuo quickly settled into the tribe. Together with his chief of an older brother, he led the tribe into thriving development.
Clearing land, petting fluff, farming, petting fluff, raising livestock, petting fluff, building houses, petting fluff…
But misfortune struck without warning. Just as Lang Shuo began living his happy life of petting fluffy creatures anytime, anywhere, his older brother suddenly disappeared while out trading for supplies. With half its warriors gone, the tribe became like a piece of fat meat. The surrounding tribes watched greedily, each wanting to take a bite.
Beset by troubles within and enemies without, Lang Shuo had no solution. He could only seek help from the only tribe that had not made a move against them—the Black Wolf Tribe—only to be told they would guard territory only for a mate.
With nowhere left to turn, Lang Shuo gritted his teeth and agreed.

224535.synopsis:
As a trainee on the hottest survival show right now,
if they had to pick the one who left the strongest impression, it would without a doubt be Su Yang.
From his appearance to talent, Su Yang is absolutely top-tier on the show. On top of that, the mentors particularly favor Su Yang.
Everyone can tell that Su Yang’s background was anything, but ordinary.
Some trainees want to make friends with Su Yang, but they were also intimidated by Su Yang’s aloof demeanor.
Whether he was facing the mentors or his roommates, Su Yang was rarely seen smiling, and he seemed to cherish words like gold.
If someone walks in Su Yang’s direction, he will directly turn his face away to avoid the other person’s gaze, or even turn around and leave.
He spends most of his days away from the dorm and out of the cameras’ reach, making it painfully clear he wants nothing to do with anyone.
Until one day, they unexpectedly found him inside a bathroom stall.
